intro: Designed to bring style and efficiency to your workspace, the Mayfair Desk blends a sleek finish with smart storage, keeping your office organised and inspiring productivity.

features.title: Clutter-free workspace
features.text: Built-in grommets keep wires neatly managed, so you can stay focused without messy distractions.

features.title: Spacious yet compact
features.text: A wide worktop with smart storage helps you work efficiently while saving space in small or mid-sized offices.

features.title: Modern & sophisticated
features.text: Its clean lines and softened edges add a refined touch that fits seamlessly into any office.

features.title: Designed for small spaces
features.text: A compact footprint maximizes function without taking up too much room, perfect for any work setting.

features.title: Easy to maintain
features.text: The durable, pre-laminated board resists wear and tear, staying stylish with minimal upkeep.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Mayfair Office Desk 900 W
